description: This file contains unit tests for the PolicyTrie class, which is part of an enforcer mechanism in the Eclipse Ditto project. The tests validate functionality such as construction from policies, seeking to specific nodes, computing transitive closures, and JSON view building within the PolicyTrie data structure.

classes.name: PolicyTrieTest
classes.description: Unit test class for PolicyTrie, testing creation, search, traversal, and JSON view functionalities.

methods.name: initTestConstants
methods.description: Initializes static test constants before any tests run.

methods.name: initTestVariables
methods.description: Initializes the PolicyTrie instance before each test.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceFromNullPolicy
methods.description: Tests that creating a PolicyTrie from null throws a NullPointerException.

methods.name: getJsonKeyIteratorReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies the JSON key iterator returns the correct sequence for a resource path.

methods.name: getGrandRevokeIndexOnRootReturnsEmptyIndex
methods.description: Checks that the root node has an empty GrantRevokeIndex.

methods.name: policyTrieHasChildThing
methods.description: Verifies the PolicyTrie correctly reports the existence of a child node.

methods.name: seekToLeastAncestorOfBarResourcePath
methods.description: Tests seeking to the least ancestor node for a specific resource path.

methods.name: seekToExactNodeReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that seeking to an exact node retrieves the expected grant/revoke index.

methods.name: getTransitiveClosureReturnsExpected
methods.description: Validates the transitive closure of the trie produces expected nodes with correct indices.

methods.name: buildJsonViewOfNullValue
methods.description: Tests building a JSON view from a null value results in a null JSON object.
